cards.target: Vi har inte tid.
cards.english: We don't have time.

cards.target: Jag har knappast sovit.
cards.english: I have hardly slept.

cards.target: Hon gillar inte vinter.
cards.english: She doesn't like winter.

cards.target: Jag brukar inte klaga.
cards.english: I don't usually complain.

cards.target: Vi handlar på ICA.
cards.english: We shop at ICA.

cards.target: Jag åker med tåg.
cards.english: I go by train.

cards.target: Jag ser inte problemet.
cards.english: I don't see the problem.

cards.target: Hon väntar på stationen.
cards.english: She waits at the station.

cards.target: Jag studerar på universitetet.
cards.english: I study at the university.

cards.target: De bor nära centrum.
cards.english: They live near the center.

cards.target: Han skrattar åt skämtet.
cards.english: He laughs at the joke.

cards.target: Jag springer i affären.
cards.english: I'm running around in the store.

cards.target: Boken ligger i lådan.
cards.english: The book is in the box.

cards.target: Hon väntar vid busshållplatsen.
cards.english: She waits at the bus stop.

cards.target: Faktiskt tycker jag om vintern.
cards.english: Actually, I like winter.

cards.target: Han har inte ens försökt.
cards.english: He hasn't even tried.

cards.target: Vi ska inte vara oroliga.
cards.english: We shouldn't be worried.

cards.target: Överallt ser man svenska flaggor.
cards.english: Everywhere you see Swedish flags.

cards.target: Jag jobbar inte på fredagar.
cards.english: I don't work on Fridays.

cards.target: De har aldrig varit här.
cards.english: They have never been here.

cards.target: Vi kunde inte hitta vägen.
cards.english: We couldn't find the way.

cards.target: Han ska inte behöva vänta.
cards.english: He shouldn't have to wait.

cards.target: De kom inte i tid.
cards.english: They didn't arrive on time.

cards.target: Vi ses om en timme.
cards.english: We'll meet in an hour.

cards.target: Hon är bra på svenska.
cards.english: She is good at Swedish.

cards.target: Januari är den kallaste månaden.
cards.english: January is the coldest month.

cards.target: Vintern är den kallaste årstiden.
cards.english: Winter is the coldest season.

cards.target: Nedanför berget ligger en by.
cards.english: Below the mountain lies a village.

cards.target: Jag brukade inte gilla det.
cards.english: I didn't use to like it.

cards.target: Sväng till höger vid trafikljuset.
cards.english: Turn right at the traffic light.

cards.target: Det spelar inte så stor roll.
cards.english: It doesn't really matter.

cards.target: Jag har inte träffat henne förut.
cards.english: I haven't met her before.

cards.target: Vi hade inte tid att vänta.
cards.english: We didn't have time to wait.

cards.target: Fortfarande bor hon i samma stad.
cards.english: She still lives in the same city.

cards.target: Nog kan du stanna lite till.
cards.english: You could certainly stay a bit longer.

cards.target: Vi kliver av vid nästa station.
cards.english: We get off at the next station.

cards.target: Hon tycker inte att det är svårt.
cards.english: She doesn't think it's difficult.

cards.target: Jag hoppas att det inte regnar snart.
cards.english: I hope it doesn't rain soon.

cards.target: Vi har aldrig haft det här problemet.
cards.english: We have never had this problem.

cards.target: Vi stänger klockan arton just nu också.
cards.english: We close at eighteen right now too.

cards.target: Ska vi ses imorgon nästa vecka nu?
cards.english: Shall we meet tomorrow next week now?

cards.target: En ny restaurang öppnade nära vårt kontor.
cards.english: A new restaurant opened near our office.

cards.target: Jag kommer hem från jobbet på kvällen.
cards.english: I get home from work in the evening.

cards.target: De köpte ett stort hus nära sjön.
cards.english: They bought a big house near the lake.

cards.target: Jag läste en tjock bok under semestern.
cards.english: I read a thick book during the holiday.

cards.target: Förr eller senare kommer sanningen fram snart.
cards.english: Sooner or later the truth will come out.

cards.target: Golvet är smutsigare än igår efter festen.
cards.english: The floor is dirtier than yesterday after the party.

cards.target: Vädret idag är lika bra som igår.
cards.english: The weather today is just as good as yesterday.

cards.target: En fattig familj fick hjälp av sina grannar.
cards.english: A poor family received help from their neighbors.

cards.target: Jag hittade en mer intressant bok på biblioteket.
cards.english: I found a more interesting book at the library.

cards.target: Troligen kommer det att snöa imorgon enligt prognosen.
cards.english: Probably it will snow tomorrow according to the forecast.

cards.target: Vi åker på lördag under sommaren med familjen.
cards.english: We're going away on a Saturday in summer with the family.

cards.target: Vi satt ute en ljus sommarkväll och pratade.
cards.english: We sat outside on a bright summer evening and talked.

cards.target: Jag tycker om att promenera i skogen på hösten.
cards.english: I like to walk in the forest in autumn.

cards.target: Det kalla vattnet i sjön fick oss att huttra.
cards.english: The cold water in the lake made us shiver.

cards.target: Skogen bakom huset är full av blåbär på sommaren.
cards.english: The forest behind the house is full of blueberries in summer.

cards.target: Det tyngsta paketet behövde bäras av två starka personer.
cards.english: The heaviest package needed to be carried by two strong people.

cards.target: Vi får se vad som händer imorgon, man vet aldrig.
cards.english: We will see what happens tomorrow, you never know.

cards.target: Jag fick inte svar trots att jag väntade hela veckan.
cards.english: I didn't get an answer even though I waited all week.

cards.target: Ett litet barn satt på golvet och lekte med klossar.
cards.english: A small child sat on the floor and played with blocks.

cards.target: Tack så mycket för din hjälp med allting idag verkligen.
cards.english: Thank you so much for your help with everything today.

cards.target: Ibland tar det lång tid att hitta en ledig parkering.
cards.english: Sometimes it takes a long time to find a free parking spot.

cards.target: Jag ser dig varje morgon på väg till jobbet i stan.
cards.english: I see you every morning on the way to work in town.

cards.target: Å ena sidan är det billigt, å andra sidan är det långt bort.
cards.english: On one hand it's cheap, on the other hand it's far away.

cards.target: Luciatåget ses i december.
cards.english: The Lucia procession takes place in December.

cards.target: Framför skolan stannar bussen.
cards.english: The bus stops in front of the school.

existing_tips: "Kan inte" = can't. Negation always after the modal verb in main clauses.
"Tycker inte om" = don't like. "Inte" splits "tycker" and "om" (particle).
Swedish dropped formal `you` in the 1960s-70s (`du-reformen`). Unlike French/German/Russian, there i
Tipping is not expected in Sweden – service charge is usually included.
'Alltid' (always) – goes after the verb in main clauses: 'Jag äter alltid frukost'.
